item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #MINPRSD
Issued at 08:30 PM 28 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #SurigaoDelSur(Tago, Cagwait, Marihatag, Bayabas, SanAgustin, Lianga, SanMiguel, Carmen, Madrid, Cantilan, Carrascal), #AgusanDelSur(Rosario, SanFrancisco, Prosperidad, CityOfBayugan, Sibagat), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Siocon, Sirawai, Baliguian), #ZamboangaSibugay(Titay and Naga) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #SurigaoDelSur(CityOfTandag, Cortes, Lanuza, Hinatuan, Barobo, Tagbina), #ZamboangaSibugay(RosellerLim, Tungawan and Ipil) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
